method: Independent re-check in the Higgsfield sandbox: Commons API (live wikitext, full revision history of every licence tag, log events, deletion-request and talk pages, user groups), rendered Template:PD-algorithm and VulcanSphere licence template, curl -sIL of every media_url plus sha1 comparison with Commons imageinfo, Wayback copy of openai.com/sora (prompt-to-file mapping, statements, footer, download links), OpenAI Terms snapshot, developer CDN originals downloaded and frame-diffed (1 fps gray) against the Commons copies, ffprobe/volumedetect/scene-spike analysis, temporal-median corner rendering to detect burned-in watermarks, primary-source fetches (blog.google, gemini.google release notes, research.google, stability.ai, CompVis LICENSE, about.fb.com, deepmind.google). No frame was viewed by me; every visual statement is pixel analysis or metadata.
global_notes: None of OpenAI, Google DeepMind or Google Research publishes a reuse licence for these demos. Every Sora/Veo-demo clearance rests on Commons' PD-algorithm tag (uploader assertion). OpenAI's site says '(c) 2015 - 2024 OpenAI' and its Terms claim all rights in its Services, so this is a residual-risk decision for the project, not a grant.

Only VulcanSphere's CC0 clips (Veo 3, Veo 3.1) and the Veo 2 clock (CC0 by the generator) rest on an explicit creator dedication; the two VulcanSphere Veo clips carry a burned-in 'Veo' watermark that must stay visible.
Licence history matters: Commons tags change. The SD 1.4 clip's PD-algorithm tag was put there by an anonymous IP; the creator's own grant was CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL.

Lead for other hunters (not evaluated): deepmind.google/models/veo/ hosts about 69 sample-video URLs on storage.googleapis.com/gdm-deepmind-com-prod-public (e.g. veo__controls__camera-controls__*.mp4, veo__controls__character-consistency__output-*.webm) under a page credit line 'All the clips were generated directly with Veo without modifications'; reuse terms not checked.
Higgsfield video-analysis jobs were not used: the shared queue holds 50+ queued jobs that had not started.
